bbff4db5-ff6a-41ad-ab21-950b45c543c0.name: Granular Synthesis
bbff4db5-ff6a-41ad-ab21-950b45c543c0.description: Sample-free polyphonic stereo grain3 synthesizer with 30 performance controls. From sparse grains and glassy clouds to dense pads, noisy swarms and sync-like tones. Two independently seeded grain streams; harmonic/odd-even source shaping, five grain windows, pitch/phase scatter and distributions, evolving density/duration/phase/pitch, resonant filters, ADSR and stereo width. Pan and output level are set in the performance rack. Best MIDI 36–84. Window: 1 Hamming, 2 Hann, 3 triangle, 4 Blackman, 5 Blackman-Harris. Window, transpose, sync, follow and seed round to integers. Performance controllers apply to NEW notes; internal motion continues on held notes. Dry Stereo Output: route to Master; add shared reverb/delay to taste.

gs_wave::iarg2.expression: rich * even * ((1 - 2 * (hz * ampdb((floor(transpose + .5) * 100 + detune + vibrato) * .0050171665944) * (1 + scatter)) / 18000) + abs((1 - 2 * (hz * ampdb((floor(transpose + .5) * 100 + detune + vibrato) * .0050171665944) * (1 + scatter)) / 18000))) / 4

gs_wave::iarg3.expression: rich * ((1 - 3 * (hz * ampdb((floor(transpose + .5) * 100 + detune + vibrato) * .0050171665944) * (1 + scatter)) / 18000) + abs((1 - 3 * (hz * ampdb((floor(transpose + .5) * 100 + detune + vibrato) * .0050171665944) * (1 + scatter)) / 18000))) / 6

gs_wave::iarg4.expression: rich * even * ((1 - 4 * (hz * ampdb((floor(transpose + .5) * 100 + detune + vibrato) * .0050171665944) * (1 + scatter)) / 18000) + abs((1 - 4 * (hz * ampdb((floor(transpose + .5) * 100 + detune + vibrato) * .0050171665944) * (1 + scatter)) / 18000))) / 8

gs_wave::iarg5.expression: rich * ((1 - 5 * (hz * ampdb((floor(transpose + .5) * 100 + detune + vibrato) * .0050171665944) * (1 + scatter)) / 18000) + abs((1 - 5 * (hz * ampdb((floor(transpose + .5) * 100 + detune + vibrato) * .0050171665944) * (1 + scatter)) / 18000))) / 10

gs_wave::iarg6.expression: rich * even * ((1 - 6 * (hz * ampdb((floor(transpose + .5) * 100 + detune + vibrato) * .0050171665944) * (1 + scatter)) / 18000) + abs((1 - 6 * (hz * ampdb((floor(transpose + .5) * 100 + detune + vibrato) * .0050171665944) * (1 + scatter)) / 18000))) / 12

gs_wave::iarg7.expression: rich * ((1 - 7 * (hz * ampdb((floor(transpose + .5) * 100 + detune + vibrato) * .0050171665944) * (1 + scatter)) / 18000) + abs((1 - 7 * (hz * ampdb((floor(transpose + .5) * 100 + detune + vibrato) * .0050171665944) * (1 + scatter)) / 18000))) / 14

gs_wave::iarg8.expression: rich * even * ((1 - 8 * (hz * ampdb((floor(transpose + .5) * 100 + detune + vibrato) * .0050171665944) * (1 + scatter)) / 18000) + abs((1 - 8 * (hz * ampdb((floor(transpose + .5) * 100 + detune + vibrato) * .0050171665944) * (1 + scatter)) / 18000))) / 16

gs_filter_hz::a.expression: (cutoff * ampdb(6.02059991328 * (depth * env + motion * lfo)) + 18000 - abs(cutoff * ampdb(6.02059991328 * (depth * env + motion * lfo)) - 18000)) / 2

gs_gain::kin.expression: .28 * amp * ampdb(level) / (1 + .5 * density * duration * .001 * (1 + dm) * (1 + gm))

gs_grain_l::kphs.expression: phase + -1 * scan * lfo - floor(phase + -1 * scan * lfo)

gs_grain_r::kphs.expression: phase + 1 * scan * lfo - floor(phase + 1 * scan * lfo)

979b006c-d2a5-47c1-836c-9f3f30453ddf.name: Analog Drumkit
979b006c-d2a5-47c1-836c-9f3f30453ddf.description: 17 velocity-sensitive, sample-free analog percussion voices. GM notes: 35 kick, 36 distorted kick, 37 side stick, 38 snare, 39 clap, 40 electric snare, 41/43/45/47/48/50 low-to-high toms, 42 closed hat, 46 open hat, 49 crash, 51 ride, 54 tambourine. Existing sounds and settings retained. BD snappiness, shared hat tuning and snare tuning default to 1 (original sound). Each added voice has its own characteristic control. Finite one-shot tails survive short note-offs; unmapped notes are silent. Stereo output.

hihat_open_highpass::asig.expression: metal1 + metal2 + metal3 + metal4 + metal5 + metal6 + air

hihat_closed_highpass::asig.expression: metal1 + metal2 + metal3 + metal4 + metal5 + metal6 + air

tambourine_pan::asig.expression: (s0 + s1 + s2 + s3 + s4 + s5 + s6) * amplitude

crash_mix::a.expression: metal * body + wash * wash_env * 0.65 + air * fizz * 0.20 + stick * strike * 0.3

ride_mix::a.expression: metal * body + wash * wash_env * 0.55 * brightness + air * fizz * 0.16 * brightness + stick * strike * 0.28 + ping * ping_env

d5a1c75b-10ff-4b75-a1c5-65371ecac335.name: Stereo Delay
d5a1c75b-10ff-4b75-a1c5-65371ecac335.description: Tempo-synced stereo delay with unity dry signal. Tempo (40–180 BPM, default 120), Beats (1–16, default 4): echo interval = 60 * Beats / Tempo seconds. Feedback (0–0.9, default 0.5) scales every echo; zero is dry only. Stereo (0–1, default 0.5) blends preserved stereo with alternating mono-average echoes, first left, then right. Use as an insert. Set tempo manually; restart the rack after changing controls. Dry plus echoes can exceed full scale.

sd_mix_left::b.expression: (1 - width) * (odd + gain * gain * even) + width * (odd + other) / 2

sd_mix_right::b.expression: (1 - width) * (odd + gain * gain * even) + width * gain * gain * (even + other) / 2

edec9fff-768b-4de1-b892-53eb4249b2bf.name: Reverb Effect
edec9fff-768b-4de1-b892-53eb4249b2bf.description: Stereo reverb effect, uses inleta channel names "left" and "right".

add3fae2-888e-467c-838a-4ebcba082e6c.name: Tube Overdrive
add3fae2-888e-467c-838a-4ebcba082e6c.description: Warm stereo tube-style saturation: biased tanh, input filtering, DC removal and tone control. Drive (0–24 dB), Tone (2–12 kHz), Output (−18 to +6 dB). Restart the rack after changing performance controls. Fully wet; use as an insert. 0 dB Drive is not bypass. No oversampling or cabinet simulation.
